response.justification: The candidate demonstrates strong software development skills and a broad technical background, but their experience is heavily skewed toward web, mobile, and full-stack development with limited direct exposure to the core C++ and industrial automation requirements of the role. Their open-source contributions and diverse project history show adaptability, but the lack of recent C++ focus and industrial cybersecurity experience raises concerns about fit.
strengths: Extensive experience with event-driven architectures, multi-threading, and distributed systems (e.g., GISCollective, Sociomantic).
Strong track record in mentoring, technical documentation, and agile methodologies (e.g., workshops, code katas, TDD).
Diverse open-source contributions and problem-solving skills across multiple domains (e.g., DLang, Node.js, IoT-adjacent projects).
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience; last direct involvement appears to be at National Instruments (2014–2015).
No explicit mention of industrial cybersecurity standards (e.g., IEC 62443) or Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) practices.
Primary expertise lies in web/mobile stacks (TypeScript, React, Node.js), which are not core to this role.
